meta.title: Credential Retrieval API — Withdrawing DB Passwords

views.label: Fetch + use
views.note: The password is fetched live, used once, and dropped.

messages.label: GETDEL token → db_type, db_user, db_ip, db_port
login with db_user + password — MySQL handshake / PG startup / MSSQL Login7
password reference dropped — memory only, never logged or sent client-ward

cards.title: Hygiene rules (hard)
items: Password held in a local variable for the connect call only
Never logged — and non-200 bodies (which could echo it) are drained, never surfaced
Never travels client-ward; the maker only ever sees its token

cards.title: Contract
items: Query params come from the token payload, not the maker's username
Response bodies are read with a hard 1 MiB cap
Internal identity key: dbtype:user@ip:port — the one place to update for new DB types

cards.title: Fail-fast config
items: credentials_source: api with empty url → startup error naming the field
